findings.finding: Menu receives concrete trader and Inventory.player; validity compares merchant tradingPlayer by object identity. MerchantContainer has two payment slots and output2, offer reference and selectionHint. Client constructor instead uses ClientSideMerchant. This is actual producer/interface wiring only, not whole server packet security or current Dynasty custom NPC implementation.

Offer satisfaction compares item ID plus required ordinary tag when hasTag, then counts. Required null OR emptyCompound tag both have hasTagfalse and therefore no tag restriction. Required nonempty compounds recursively require their keys, permit offered extra compound keys; compareNbt false makes Lists use equals rather than unordered subset matching. It is not exact whole functional-state validation or all forge capability compatibility.

PriceA is current base count + nonnegative floored demand component + special diff, clamped1..max; nonempty price copy retains ordinary tags via copyWithCount. take first checks full satisfaction, then shrinks current A and optional B. It does not itself check isOutOfStock or encode destination/player/quest identity; caller controls preview. Current prices can depend on mutable merchant state; no durable reservation/atomicity guarantee.

Positive in-range hint selects one exact index; hint0/invalid scans first satisfying offer, not necessarily first in-stock offer. Container clears activeOffer then current offer matching tries swapped payments when first null/outofstock. Selected eligible offer assembles preview and futureXp; no debit. Empty-offers branch has no explicit preview/futureXp clear here; no reachable stale-output exploit asserted.

assemble returns configured result.copy, not a tag merge from paid materials. copy creates new item with serialized capabilities then copies ordinary tag directly when nonnull; the framework capability constructors/serialization internals are not fully audited. Result template is live getResult reference, assembled copy identity is not final inventory identity.

Auto-fill moves only exact same item/same tags/areCapsCompatible inventory stacks into payment slots, up to maxStackSize, not just cost count. Native manual offer predicate instead permits extra ordinary compound keys. Therefore auto-fill candidate rejection does not prove manual trade ineligibility; do not make quest material membership equal to auto-fill matching.
